source.title: Lurgan Mail, 23 May 1952, p. 7 ("No contests for elections to rural councils")
source.publisher: Lurgan Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)

note: Triennial election of the seven electoral divisions of Moira rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests: seven nominations were received for the seven seats. J. C. G. McQuoid was the only new member, for Donacloney in place of W. H. Irwin. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Ballyleney' to Ballyleny (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Moira Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballyleny; the rounds were filed as Ballyleny (1899, 1930, 1936, 1961, 1964, 1967); Ballyleney (1927, 1933, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Ballyleney', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (ballyleney) answers with a redirect to this one.
